content_of_post_to_comment: I saw a girlie have a complete crash out about how nobody cares about her music and all her efforts to make it work. Yeah and? You can’t “make” anyone care about what you create. If you can’t do something for the love of it, you’ll lose your mind in the process. Creative fields will stay some of the most unfair fields that there are. You are very dependent on other people seeing you and being willing to give you the time of the day, while there are hundreds of people competing for their attention every week on social media. If you can’t create like your sanity depends on it, you won’t be able to even put a dent in anything. Most odds are stacked against you, but if you can have fun with it, you win, whatever the outcome is.
comment: There’s a strange tension in creative work: needing an audience while not letting the audience become the reason you create. The hardest skill may be caring deeply without making attention the measure of meaning.
